no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per 2025 10-K, the Company has no active enrolling clinical trials. Company is in monetization mode for legacy lead candidates PV-10 (intratumoral rose bengal sodium for oncology) and PH-10 (topical rose bengal sodium for dermatology), pursuing co-development/licensing transactions. Going-concern doubt disclosed. All four ctgov trials are either TERMINATED (NCT02288897 P3 melanoma) or UNKNOWN status with primary completion dates 2021-2023 (NCT00986661, NCT02557321, NCT02693067). 10-K explicitly notes 'absence of active clinical trials in Australia during the current period' and decreased clinical trial costs.
